ayahs.arabicText: قٓ١ۚ۫ وَ الْقُرْاٰنِ الْمَجِیْدِۚ
ayahs.translation: Qaf. By the glorious Qur'an.

ayahs.arabicText: بَلْ عَجِبُوْۤا اَنْ جَآءَهُمْ مُّنْذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ هٰذَا شَیْءٌ عَجِیْبٌۚ
ayahs.translation: Nay; they wondered that a warner should have come to them from among themselves. The unbelievers said: “This indeed is a strange thing.

ayahs.arabicText: ءَاِذَا مِتْنَا وَ كُنَّا تُرَابًا١ۚ ذٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِیْدٌ
ayahs.translation: What! When we are dead and reduced to mere dust, (shall we be raised to life)? Such a return is far-fetched.”

ayahs.arabicText: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنْقُصُ الْاَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ١ۚ وَ عِنْدَنَا كِتٰبٌ حَفِیْظٌ
ayahs.translation: (Thus do they imagine, although) We know well what the earth takes away from them. With Us is a Record that preserves everything.

ayahs.arabicText: بَلْ كَذَّبُوْا بِالْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِیْۤ اَمْرٍ مَّرِیْجٍ
ayahs.translation: They gave the lie to the Truth when it came to them. So they are now in a state of great perplexity.

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَلَمْ یَنْظُرُوْۤا اِلَى السَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَیْفَ بَنَیْنٰهَا وَ زَیَّنّٰهَا وَ مَا لَهَا مِنْ فُرُوْجٍ
ayahs.translation: Did they never observe the sky above them: how We built it and beautified it; and it has no cracks;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الْاَرْضَ مَدَدْنٰهَا وَ اَلْقَیْنَا فِیْهَا رَوَاسِیَ وَ اَنْۢبَتْنَا فِیْهَا مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِیْجٍۙ
ayahs.translation: and We have spread out the earth, and have set upon it firm mountains, and have caused it to bring out plants of all beauteous kinds?

ayahs.arabicText: تَبْصِرَةً وَّ ذِكْرٰى لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِیْبٍ
ayahs.translation: All these are to serve as eye openers and as a lesson to every being who is prone to turn (to the Truth).

ayahs.arabicText: وَ نَزَّلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً مُّبٰرَكًا فَاَنْۢبَتْنَا بِهٖ جَنّٰتٍ وَّ حَبَّ الْحَصِیْدِۙ
ayahs.translation: We also sent down blessed water from the heaven, wherewith We caused gardens and harvest-grain to grow,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ النَّخْلَ بٰسِقٰتٍ لَّهَا طَلْعٌ نَّضِیْدٌۙ
ayahs.translation: and tall palm-trees with their thickly-clustered spathes;

ayahs.arabicText: رِّزْقًا لِّلْعِبَادِ١ۙ وَ اَحْیَیْنَا بِهٖ بَلْدَةً مَّیْتًا١ؕ كَذٰلِكَ الْخُرُوْجُ
ayahs.translation: all this as sustenance for Our servants. And thus We do bring the dead land back to life with water. Such shall be the coming forth (of human beings from the earth).

ayahs.arabicText: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوْحٍ وَّ اَصْحٰبُ الرَّسِّ وَ ثَمُوْدُۙ
ayahs.translation: In the past Noah's people, and the people of Rass and Thamud gave the lie (to Messengers),

ayahs.arabicText: وَ عَادٌ وَّ فِرْعَوْنُ وَ اِخْوَانُ لُوْطٍۙ
ayahs.translation: and so did 'Ad, and Pharaoh and Lot's brethren,

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ اَصْحٰبُ الْاَیْكَةِ وَ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ١ؕ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِیْدِ
ayahs.translation: and the people of Aykah, and the people of Tubba'. They all gave the lie to the Messengers. Thereafter My threat of chastisement against them was fulfilled.

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَعَیِیْنَا بِالْخَلْقِ الْاَوَّلِ١ؕ بَلْ هُمْ فِیْ لَبْسٍ مِّنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِیْدٍ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Did We, then, become worn out by the first creation? Not at all; but they are in doubt about a fresh creation.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ وَ نَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهٖ نَفْسُهٗ١ۖۚ وَ نَحْنُ اَقْرَبُ اِلَیْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِیْدِ
ayahs.translation: Surely We have created man, and We know the promptings of his heart, and We are nearer to him than even his jugular vein.

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْ یَتَلَقَّى الْمُتَلَقِّیٰنِ عَنِ الْیَمِیْنِ وَ عَنِ الشِّمَالِ قَعِیْدٌ
ayahs.translation: Moreover, there are two scribes, one each sitting on the right and the left, recording everything.

ayahs.arabicText: مَا یَلْفِظُ مِنْ قَوْلٍ اِلَّا لَدَیْهِ رَقِیْبٌ عَتِیْدٌ
ayahs.translation: He utters not a word, but there is a vigilant watcher at hand.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ جَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ الْمَوْتِ بِالْحَقِّ١ؕ ذٰلِكَ مَا كُنْتَ مِنْهُ تَحِیْدُ
ayahs.translation: Lo, the agony of death has indeed come with the Truth. That is what you had sought to avoid.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ نُفِخَ فِی الصُّوْرِ١ؕ ذٰلِكَ یَوْمُ الْوَعِیْدِ
ayahs.translation: And then the Trumpet was blown. This is the day of the promised chastisement.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ جَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌ وَّ شَهِیْدٌ
ayahs.translation: Everyone has come, each attended by one who will drive him on, and another who will bear witness.

ayahs.arabicText: لَقَدْ كُنْتَ فِیْ غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنْكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ الْیَوْمَ حَدِیْدٌ
ayahs.translation: You were heedless of this. Now We have removed your veil and so your vision today is sharp.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ قَرِیْنُهٗ هٰذَا مَا لَدَیَّ عَتِیْدٌؕ
ayahs.translation: His companion said: “Here is he who was in my charge.”

ayahs.arabicText: اَلْقِیَا فِیْ جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِیْدٍۙ
ayahs.translation: The command was given: “Cast into Hell every hardened, stubborn unbeliever,

ayahs.arabicText: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَیْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُّرِیْبِۙ
ayahs.translation: who hinders good, exceeds the limits, is immersed in doubts,

ayahs.arabicText: اِ۟لَّذِیْ جَعَلَ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ فَاَلْقِیٰهُ فِی الْعَذَابِ الشَّدِیْدِ
ayahs.translation: and has set up another deity with Allah. Hurl him into the grievous torment.”

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ قَرِیْنُهٗ رَبَّنَا مَاۤ اَطْغَیْتُهٗ وَ لٰكِنْ كَانَ فِیْ ضَلٰلٍۭ بَعِیْدٍ
ayahs.translation: His companion said: “I did not incite him to rebel; he was far gone into error of his own accord.”

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوْا لَدَیَّ وَ قَدْ قَدَّمْتُ اِلَیْكُمْ بِالْوَعِیْدِ
ayahs.translation: (It was said): “Do not remonstrate in My presence. I had warned you.

ayahs.arabicText: مَا یُبَدَّلُ الْقَوْلُ لَدَیَّ وَ مَاۤ اَنَا بِظَلَّامٍ لِّلْعَبِیْدِ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: My Word is not changed; and never do I inflict the least wrong upon My servants.”

ayahs.arabicText: یَوْمَ نَقُوْلُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ امْتَلَاْتِ وَ تَقُوْلُ هَلْ مِنْ مَّزِیْدٍ
ayahs.translation: On that Day We shall ask Hell: “Are you full?” And it will reply: “Are there any more?”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اُزْلِفَتِ الْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِیْنَ غَیْرَ بَعِیْدٍ
ayahs.translation: And when Paradise shall be brought close to the God-fearing, and will no longer be far away,

ayahs.arabicText: هٰذَا مَا تُوْعَدُوْنَ لِكُلِّ اَوَّابٍ حَفِیْظٍۚ
ayahs.translation: it will be said: “This is what you were promised, a promise made to everyone who turned much (to Allah) and was watchful of his conduct,

ayahs.arabicText: مَنْ خَشِیَ الرَّحْمٰنَ بِالْغَیْبِ وَ جَآءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُّنِیْبِۙ
ayahs.translation: to everyone who feared the Merciful One though He is beyond the reach of perception, to everyone who has come with a heart ever wont to turn (to Him).

ayahs.arabicText: اِ۟دْخُلُوْهَا بِسَلٰمٍ١ؕ ذٰلِكَ یَوْمُ الْخُلُوْدِ
ayahs.translation: Enter this Paradise in peace.” That will be the Day of Eternity.

ayahs.arabicText: لَهُمْ مَّا یَشَآءُوْنَ فِیْهَا وَ لَدَیْنَا مَزِیْدٌ
ayahs.translation: Therein they shall get whatever they desire; and with Us there is even more.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِّنْ قَرْنٍ هُمْ اَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوْا فِی الْبِلَادِ١ؕ هَلْ مِنْ مَّحِیْصٍ
ayahs.translation: How many a nation did We destroy before them that were stronger in prowess than these. They searched about the lands of the world. But could they find a refuge?

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَذِكْرٰى لِمَنْ كَانَ لَهٗ قَلْبٌ اَوْ اَلْقَى السَّمْعَ وَ هُوَ شَهِیْدٌ
ayahs.translation: Verily there is a lesson in this for everyone who has a (sound) heart and who listens with an attentive mind.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضَ وَ مَا بَیْنَهُمَا فِیْ سِتَّةِ اَیَّامٍ١ۖۗ وَّ مَا مَسَّنَا مِنْ لُّغُوْبٍ
ayahs.translation: We created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six days, and weariness did not even touch Us.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاصْبِرْ عَلٰى مَا یَقُوْلُوْنَ وَ سَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوْعِ الشَّمْسِ وَ قَبْلَ الْغُرُوْبِۚ
ayahs.translation: Hence bear with patience whatever they say, and celebrate your Lord's glory before the rising of the sun and before its setting;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مِنَ الَّیْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَ اَدْبَارَ السُّجُوْدِ
ayahs.translation: and in the night, too, celebrate His glory, in the wake of prostration.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اسْتَمِعْ یَوْمَ یُنَادِ الْمُنَادِ مِنْ مَّكَانٍ قَرِیْبٍۙ
ayahs.translation: Hearken on the Day when the caller will call from a place nearby,

ayahs.arabicText: یَّوْمَ یَسْمَعُوْنَ الصَّیْحَةَ بِالْحَقِّ١ؕ ذٰلِكَ یَوْمُ الْخُرُوْجِ
ayahs.translation: the Day when they shall hear the Blast in truth. That will be the Day (for the dead) to come forth.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْیٖ وَ نُمِیْتُ وَ اِلَیْنَا الْمَصِیْرُۙ
ayahs.translation: Surely it is We Who give life and cause death, and to Us shall all return

ayahs.arabicText: یَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ الْاَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا١ؕ ذٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَیْنَا یَسِیْرٌ
ayahs.translation: on the Day when the earth will be rent asunder and people, rising from it, will hasten forth. To assemble them all will be easy for Us.

ayahs.arabicText: نَحْنُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا یَقُوْلُوْنَ وَ مَاۤ اَنْتَ عَلَیْهِمْ بِجَبَّارٍ١۫ فَذَكِّرْ بِالْقُرْاٰنِ مَنْ یَّخَافُ وَعِیْدِ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet), We are well aware of what they say; and you are not required to force things on them. So exhort with the Qur'an all those who fear My warning.
